tenure standpoint

  • CURIE: gmeow:tenureStandpoint
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureStandpoint
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/standpoint

The standpoint whose position a standpoint-tenure records. When a StandpointTenure generates a StandpointClaim observation, the tenureStandpoint becomes the vantage of the claim.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:StandpointTenure -> gmeow:Standpoint; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:tenureStandpoint from gmeow:StandpointTenure to gmeow:Standpoint when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:StandpointTenure, gmeow:Standpoint
